issue.title: Transfusion registers bundle omits the stock source for unit trace
issue.actual: The screen lists unit and transfusion detail and the reaction follow-up, but the statistics only contain counts and the other register reads are PDFs. The bundle does not name where a staff member picks a unit to open its trace. GET /blood/units?status=Transfused is a real authorised list.
issue.expected: Document the source list or the intended record handoff. GET /blood/units with a historical status can provide the unit number and server unit_id, then GET /blood/units/{unit_id} provides each transfusion. Keep existing blood.view.
issue.steps: Read current get_screen_bundle('blood_registers') including endpoints and handoffs, then read get_endpoint for GET /blood/units. Call the directory using the documented filter as demo.quality. Compare the resulting available source with the operations named in the bundle.
issue.evidence: DEV build 2026-11-07T10:03:18.175586+00:00. Actual source GET 200, request_id 7937d7048fd549c5942719e8f78cd93c. The selected filter had zero demo records. This report is about the missing source in the bundle. The existing call is available and permission checked.
